summary.intent: Execute Phase 22 (performance baselines completion) end-to-end: plan execution, code review/cleanup, PR creation, review resolution, staging baseline population, and merge into main.
summary.outcome: Phase 22 fully executed with 3 plans (SDK perf instrumentation, E2E journey timing, load test thresholds), PR #355 created and cleaned up through 4 rounds of automated review resolution, real baselines captured from staging after a DB reset fixed a vault init bug, and the branch successfully merged with latest main.

repo: Phase 22 planning commits were accidentally made directly to main before the feature branch existed — GSD branching strategy should be set before any commits land.
Staging DB was never reset after Phase 20 removed encrypted_root_folder_key/encrypted_root_ipns_private_key columns, causing NOT NULL constraint violations on wallet login for new accounts.
Phase 23 was completed out of order before Phase 21; the `phase complete` tool uses roadmap order to suggest next phase, not completion state — always verify actual completion status.

The mock wallet injected via Playwright's addInitScript is a real EIP-1193 provider; multiple accounts can be tested by creating separate browser contexts with independent wallets, not a special mock adapter.
upload/index.ts gained a `pinFn` parameter in Phase 21 for BYO-IPFS support, which conflicted with Phase 22's withPerf wrapping of the same function.
GitHub Actions 'lint-pr-title' workflow suddenly required manual approval where it previously ran automatically — likely a GitHub platform settings change, not a repo config change.

code.finding: Concurrent withPerf calls with the same operation name collide on mark names — fixed by adding a per-invocation counter to make mark names unique.
PerformanceMeasure entries accumulate unboundedly in long sessions — clear them immediately after creation with performance.clearMeasures().
PERF_ENABLED check via process.env can evaluate true in browser prod builds due to webpack process polyfill — guard with typeof process.env?.NODE_ENV === 'string'.
404 detection used error.status but Axios puts HTTP status on error.response.status — fixed to use AxiosError-compatible access pattern.
expectThresholdsPassed helper silently skips missing metrics by design — intentional, documented in JSDoc. The JSDoc incorrectly mentioned 'expect' (vitest) when the impl uses throw.
Using 'as any' on globalThis.performance — replaced with proper 'declare global' TypeScript declaration.

workflow: GSD executor agents spawn background tasks that send completion notifications after the phase is already done — these can be safely ignored.
Playwright journey timing tests must be run via the test runner (not Playwright MCP) because wallet injection requires page.addInitScript which only works in the test runner context.
CodeRabbit and Copilot generated 16 review threads across 4 rounds; automated reviewers sometimes re-raise the same 'not applicable' comments across rounds after new commits.
When resolving merge conflicts between two phase completions in planning docs (ROADMAP, STATE, PROJECT), both phases' data must be preserved — neither side is entirely correct.
The GSD `phase complete` CLI tool returns next_phase based on roadmap order, not actual completion state — always check the roadmap directly when phases are completed out of order.

friction: GSD phase 22 commits landed on main instead of the feature branch — required git reset and branch recreation before execution could start.
Staging DB had stale schema from Phase 20 migration that was never applied, causing 500 errors on wallet login that blocked journey timing baseline collection.
Playwright temp config file approach failed due to relative testDir paths when config is in /tmp — required passing absolute paths.
GitHub Actions lint-pr-title workflow unexpectedly required manual approval, adding friction to the CI cycle with no clear explanation.
pnpm lockfile conflicts during merge required removing the lock file to commit — indicates lockfile management across feature branches can be fragile.
CodeRabbit re-raised the CAPACITY.md table caption comment in round 4 even though it had been marked not-applicable in round 3, requiring a second reply/resolve cycle.
open_items: Journey timing baselines use PENDING markers for login-to-vault sub-phases (walletAuth, vaultLoad) — need to be populated from real staging runs once Web3Auth Core Kit MPC init time is acceptable (~23.5s is very high).
Two human verification items from phase verification: (1) run journey tests against live services to populate baselines with real data, (2) confirm Performance API marks appear in browser DevTools.
The PERF_ENABLED/__CIPHERBOX_PERF__ opt-in flag needs to be wired into the web app entrypoint to enable performance instrumentation in browser dev builds — out of scope for this PR.
Phase 21 is still actively being worked on — phases were completed out of order (22, 23 before 21).
GitHub Actions approval requirement for lint-pr-title needs investigation to understand what changed and whether it can be reverted to auto-run.
PR #355 merge commit was created locally but the transcript ends before confirming the push to remote.
